# Changelog

## 1.0.0 - 2026-08-13

- Added the closed SE04 HChaCha20, raw XChaCha20, and XChaCha20-Poly1305 corpus.
- Added empty and multi-block AEAD cases plus counter 0 and 1 raw-stream cases.
- Added one failure vocabulary and deterministic mutations for ciphertext,
  key, nonce, AAD, and all 16 tag bytes.
